title: AION 2: 15,380 accounts restricted on 21 Oct for bots, gold farming and RMT; third wave in six days (7,933 on 16 Oct, 10,326 on 17 Oct), 33,639 in all

sources.note: NC Steam notice 21 Oct 01:06Z: 15,380 accounts, 20 Oct 18:00 PDT

claims.text: normal play incl. long sessions not affected; security locks are not penalties

dl.headline:
حملة حظر واسعة
على الغش في AION 2
dl.notes: Brief: hook = the number on the first frame (numbers opener) under a headline without the figure; card 1 «في موجة 21 أكتوبر / 15,380 / حسابًا محظورًا», card 2 «منذ 16 أكتوبر / 33,639 / حسابًا في 3 موجات حظر» (the sum is ours from NC's three notices), both over the trailer moving behind; line 1 (the reason) and line 2 (normal play not affected) over the Heirs of the Broken Sky trailer's combat; under it the trailer's intro music from 0.5 s (tonal, measured). 15.0 s. numbers chosen because trailer, split and clipcard reached four today. Arabic: both skills; NCSoft as «إن سي سوفت (NCSoft)» (no glossary row). Grammar: no required edits.
